---
title: Sciatt
id: MAR-0070
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 220 g buckwheat flour
- 70 g all-purpose flour
- 120 g casera or fontina cheese
- 3.5 dl sparkling water
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Put the flours in a bowl with a pinch of salt, mix, and add the water, preferably ice-cold.
2. Beat for a few minutes with a whisk to eliminate any lumps, then let rest for an hour.
3. The proportions between buckwheat and all-purpose flour can vary, but in any case the latter must be measured in a smaller quantity than the former.
4. Cut the cheese into cubes of about 2 cm and add them to the batter, mixing again.
5. Heat plenty of oil in a pan and, when it is very hot, use a spoon to pick up the cheese cubes well coated in batter one at a time, adding them to fry as you go.
6. When the sciatt have taken on an amber color, drain them with the appropriate spatula, transfer them to a sheet of kitchen paper towel, and serve them still hot.
